bounded_work_latency.method: TranscriptFieldMatcher.match() over ONE growing cumulative transcript of N finals (the provider call), median of REPS runs; on the fix the same call also builds the normalisation source map and the occurrence trace. A last-quartile mean that does not grow past the first-quartile mean shows per-final work is bounded by the sliding window, not the session length.
